# Validation on published data sets

<!-- Generated by published_data/make_report.py from published_data/results/*.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Each script of `published_data/scripts/` fits remlax on a published data set and fits the same model with established programs. A check passes when the discrepancy is within the tolerance of `published_data/R/common.R`. Rows of kind `context` compare with values from the source paper obtained under a different model or program. They are reported and never counted.
